pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual tan contiguous regions display sub-angular to irregular polygonal shapes. Edges exhibit low-acuity gradients. Spatial area of patches is highest on the mid-shoulder and neck regions and decreases toward the posterior flank where patches become smaller and more ovoid.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous light-pelage network separates the patches. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Path thickness varies across the subject, with slightly increased width and continuity observed in the transitions between the lower neck and the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette is visible along the upper neck, appearing as short, darkened vertical protrusions against the green background.
